sentence_stem: While the children are playing outside,
full_sentence: While the children are playing outside, their parents are cooking dinner.
acceptable_variants: their parents are preparing a meal in the kitchen.

options.text: their parents cook dinner every night.
options.why_wrong: The simple present describes habits or routines. The sentence needs an action happening at the same time as the children playing.
The simple past describes a finished action in the past. The sentence needs an action happening at the same time as the playing.

options.text: their parents will cook dinner later.
options.why_wrong: The future tense describes a later action. It does not describe an action happening at the same time as the children playing.

grammar_focus: Present continuous for actions happening at the same time as another action
explanation: The connector 'while' links two actions that happen at the same time, so both clauses need the present continuous. Portuguese speakers sometimes choose the simple present for ongoing actions, so check whether the action is happening right now.
translation: Enquanto as crianças brincam lá fora, os pais delas estão cozinhando o jantar.
